breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between a 'gamma-centered' k-point grid and a 'half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack' mesh. The ground truth corrects this by only requesting a gamma-centered grid. The agent repeated the original contradictory instruction, stating to 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift'.
